title: ticfac persists closeout attempt reports nowhere: attempts 12-14's reports were lost with their worktrees
body: Attempts 11-14 each wrote a closeout report at the prescribed worktree path, but only attempt 11's was captured anywhere (decisions/3.json, 2026-09-15 02:48); the reports of attempts 12, 13 and 14 survive nowhere in the repository, and their reasoning is recoverable only from the findings they filed. A rejected or superseded attempt's analysis should not be lost with its worktree: archive each attempt's report under the run's .ticfac/ state when the channel reads it, so a re-dispatched attempt can see what its predecessors already found instead of re-deriving it from a tick's notes.
